definitions.explanation: Showy in an unpleasant, tasteless way: colors, clothes, make-up, signs or decoration that are too bright and too much. Always critical.

examples.japanese: けばけばしい⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧。
⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧けばけばしすぎる。
examples.english: Her make-up is far too heavy and loud.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧けばけばしい⟦ネオン→ネオン：08835_neon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずらり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Gaudy neon signs line the street in front of the station.

notes:
The slang adjective ⟦けばい→けばい：07847_kebai⟧ (often written ケバい) is a shortening of the same word and means wearing too much make-up or dressing too flashily.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- けばけばしい⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: garish colors
- けばけばしい⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧: heavy, loud make-up
- けばけばしい⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧: gaudy signs
- けばけばしく⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to decorate garishly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧: showy, flashy (neutral or even positive)
- {毒々|どくどく}しい: lurid, poisonous-looking (even stronger)
- ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧: plain, subdued (the opposite)
